# Billing & commerce blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Billing & commerce blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## entitlements

Active Stripe entitlements per tenant from the Stripe Sync Engine, feature_claims() for the access token hook, and has_entitlement() and tenant_ids_with_entitlement() for RLS.

- Title: Stripe entitlements
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/entitlements
- Client: `entitlementsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/entitlements`
- Modes: `managed`
- Requires: `memberships`
- Works with: `billing`, `organizations`

## usage

Usage counters per tenant, meter and day with idempotent increments, quotas per tenant or plan, within_quota() for policies and consume_quota(), which raises quota_exceeded. unreported_usage() feeds reportUsageToStripe.

- Title: Usage metering and quotas
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/usage
- Client: `usageBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/usage`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `housekeeping`
- Works with: `entitlements`, `data-lifecycle`, `invoices`, `housekeeping`
- Provides: `meter`

## billing

Each tenant's Stripe customer, seat counts (options.seatRoles) and the active subscription item from the Stripe Sync Engine, for createBilling(): checkout, the customer portal, seat sync and Stripe webhook handling.

- Title: Stripe billing
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/billing
- Client: `billingBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/billing`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `ledger`, `organizations`, `usage`
- Events (`BillingEvents`): `billing.account_linked`, `billing.customer_linked`
- Env keys: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`

## catalog

Products with options, variants and prices in minor units, price lists, a category tree, collections, sales channels, translations per locale, product media and an optional public storefront.

- Title: Catalog
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/catalog
- Client: `catalogBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/catalog`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `state-machine`, `inventory`, `attachments`, `imports`
- Entities: `product`, `product_variant`
- Tables: `products`, `product_variants`
- Permission keys: `catalog.manage`, `catalog.read`
- Events (`CatalogEvents`): `catalog.price_changed`, `product.archived`, `product.created`, `product.purged`, `product.restored`, `product.status_changed`, `product.updated`, `product_variant.created`, `product_variant.purged`, `product_variant.updated`, `storefront.published`, `storefront.unpublished`

## inventory

Stock per catalog variant and location in a unit with decimals: movements posted to the ledger block, lots, serial numbers, expiry, bins, weighted average cost, reservations with expiry, allocations with backorders, transfers, purchase requisitions with approval, and purchase orders with partial receiving into goods receipts.

- Title: Inventory
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/inventory
- Client: `inventoryBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/inventory`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `catalog`, `ledger`
- Works with: `outbox`, `assets`, `accounting`, `contacts`, `approvals`, `inspections`, `templates`, `imports`
- Entities: `inventory_location`, `purchase_order`, `purchase_requisition`, `inventory_receipt`
- Tables: `inventory_locations`, `purchase_orders`, `purchase_requisitions`, `inventory_receipts`
- Permission keys: `inventory.manage`, `inventory.read`, `inventory.reserve`, `inventory.purchase`
- Events (`InventoryEvents`): `allocation.created`, `allocation.filled`, `allocation.released`, `allocation.transferred`, `inventory_receipt.created`, `purchase_order.cancelled`, `purchase_order.line_cancelled`, `purchase_order.placed`, `purchase_order.received`, `purchase_requisition.approved`, `purchase_requisition.created`, `reservation.committed`, `reservation.created`, `reservation.released`, `stock.adjusted`, `stock.reorder_point_reached`, `transfer.cancelled`, `transfer.received`, `transfer.shipped`

## orders

Carts on anonymous or signed-in users, checkout priced from the catalog, confirmed orders from lines or an accepted quote with stock allocations, gapless order and invoice numbers, payments, fulfillments, returns and refunds, with an optional kitchen display. With invoices, a paid order gets an issued, paid invoice.

- Title: Orders
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/orders
- Client: `ordersBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/orders`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `catalog`
- Works with: `outbox`, `inventory`, `promotions`, `numbering`, `legal-entities`, `state-machine`, `invoices`, `quotes`, `contacts`, `templates`, `imports`
- Entities: `order`, `cart`
- Tables: `orders`, `carts`
- Permission keys: `orders.manage`, `orders.read`, `orders.prepare`, `orders.override_credit`
- Events (`OrdersEvents`): `fulfillment.delivered`, `fulfillment.shipped`, `order.cancelled`, `order.completed`, `order.drafted`, `order.fulfilled`, `order.hold_placed`, `order.hold_released`, `order.paid`, `order.placed`, `order.refunded`, `return.received`, `return.requested`
- Actions: `orders.from_quote`
- Providers: `payments: PaymentProvider`, `tax: TaxProvider`

## invoices

Invoices an organization sends its own customers and bills from its suppliers: drafts with lines, a gapless number per direction on issue, payments, credit notes, void and write-off, overdue and aging per currency, credit limits, the three-way match of a purchase bill, party payments split over invoices with the rest kept as credit, dunning levels, and invoices from accepted quotes.

- Title: Invoices
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/invoices
- Client: `invoicesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/invoices`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `ledger`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `catalog`, `notifications`, `numbering`, `legal-entities`, `quotes`, `relations`, `accounting`, `tax`, `inventory`, `contacts`, `orders`, `shipments`, `billable-time`, `templates`, `imports`
- Entities: `invoice`
- Tables: `invoices`
- Permission keys: `invoices.read`, `invoices.write`, `invoices.manage`, `invoices.purchase`, `invoices.override_match`, `invoices.collect`, `invoices.approve`, `invoices.send`
- Events (`InvoicesEvents`): `invoice.allocated`, `invoice.approved`, `invoice.charge_removed`, `invoice.charged`, `invoice.collection_started`, `invoice.created`, `invoice.credit_applied`, `invoice.credited`, `invoice.deleted`, `invoice.discount_applied`, `invoice.dunning_escalated`, `invoice.dunning_paused`, `invoice.e_invoice_delivered`, `invoice.e_invoice_received`, `invoice.e_invoice_rejected`, `invoice.e_invoice_sent`, `invoice.issued`, `invoice.match_checked`, `invoice.paid`, `invoice.payment_recorded`, `invoice.payment_reversed`, `invoice.unallocated`, `invoice.uncollected`, `invoice.updated`, `invoice.voided`

## ledger

- Title: Ledger
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/ledger
- Client: `ledgerBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/ledger`

- Entities: `ledger_account`, `ledger_transaction`, `ledger_hold`
- Tables: `ledger_accounts`, `ledger_transactions`, `ledger_holds`
- Permission keys: `ledger.read`, `ledger.manage`, `ledger.post`
- Events (`LedgerEvents`): `ledger_account.closed`, `ledger_account.opened`, `ledger_hold.captured`, `ledger_hold.placed`, `ledger_hold.released`, `ledger_transaction.posted`, `ledger_transaction.reversed`

## billable-time

A rate card for time entries, by member, record or organization with effective dates, and draft invoices from unbilled billable time with one line per record, member or entry, in bigint minor units. Billed entries lock until the invoice is voided.

- Title: Billable time
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/billable-time
- Client: `billableTimeBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/billable-time`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `time-entries`, `invoices`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `tasks`, `accounting`
- Entities: `time_rate`
- Tables: `time_rates`
- Permission keys: `billable_time.read`, `billable_time.manage`, `billable_time.invoice`
- Events (`BillableTimeEvents`): `time_entry.invoiced`

## leases

Leases of units (assets) to parties with rent in bigint minor units and a frequency, rent charges posted on the ledger once per period, deposits held through ledger holds, renewals and terminations. Maintenance requests are a tasks instance on the unit.

- Title: Leases
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/leases
- Client: `leasesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/leases`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `assets`, `ledger`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `accounting`
- Entities: `lease`
- Tables: `leases`
- Permission keys: `leases.read`, `leases.manage`, `leases.maintain`
- Events (`LeasesEvents`): `lease.activated`, `lease.charged`, `lease.created`, `lease.paid`, `lease.renewed`, `lease.terminated`

## expenses

Expense reports with lines in categories and receipts as attachments, spend policies (a limit per category, a receipt threshold) checked on submit, approval through the approvals block, and the approved total and its reimbursement posted on the ledger in bigint minor units. Without reports, each expense is one row a member or an employee submits and the app decides.

- Title: Expenses
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/expenses
- Client: `expensesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/expenses`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `approvals`, `ledger`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `attachments`, `employees`, `accounting`, `approvals`
- Entities: `expense_report`, `expense_line`, `expense_category`
- Tables: `expense_reports`, `expense_lines`, `expense_categories`
- Permission keys: `expenses.read`, `expenses.submit`, `expenses.approve`, `expenses.manage`
- Events (`ExpensesEvents`): `expense_category.archived`, `expense_category.restored`, `expense_report.approved`, `expense_report.cancelled`, `expense_report.created`, `expense_report.reimbursed`, `expense_report.submitted`

## accounting

Double-entry books: a chart of accounts with account roles, journals, fiscal years of periods, balanced journal entries numbered per journal and year, dimensions, exchange rates, tax codes, the trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet and general ledger, the period and year-end close, entries booked from invoices, expenses, stock, rent and gifts, tax reports and budgets.
